title: Setting multiple Array typed exports only uses the first one as default Array type in an inherited scene
body: ### Tested versions v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf] I had this problem for a while (i think like 4.5 or maybe even earlier), but as i tried shipping the game recently i analyzed it deeper. ### System information Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.92 GiB memory - WASAPI (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Was getting some weird and kind of hard to trace errors with: After a deeper analysis i found that the first array will define the subsquent types of the default/empty array of exported arrays of types in an inherited scene. This can be experimented with in the MVP i attached below where i was able to condense the problem down to its core. Here a scene with the setup: In the .tscn file: now i change it to in the .tscn after saving: When i set any values for the arrays: The arrays in the .tscn get the proper type: As soon as the first typed array gets a value, only the next array is allowed its own type and the type gets propagated down the list: ### Steps to reproduce Create a scene with a script. Create an inherited scene from that scene Add a new script to the inherited scene (extend the script) Add 2 or more Array exports with different types like ": Array[String] = []" ": Array[float] = []" save the inherited scene and check the .tscn file in a text-editor. When you change the type of the first export in the script, it will change the default values for all the following exports default values. This does not happen in a scene that is not inheriting from another scene. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [cannot-assign-contents-of-for-array-default-value-reproduction.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32876876/cannot-assign-contents-of-for-array-default-value-reproduction.zip)
